content: Observation (doc-drift): python3 tooling/doc-drift.py and make doc-drift each report exit 1 with 6 INVALID-PIN rows (09-option-result, 11-ergonomics, 12-mutual-recursion, forge/check, lower/boundary-composition, verified/proof-backends), all pinning b9704022 'not an ancestor of HEAD'. b9704022 is the REQ-0 FEATURE-branch tip (5i5F-WGLY...fb40); HEAD=60fd029e is its SQUASH-merge (#322)(#64), so the branch re-pin commit is not in history. This is the #322 28-doc re-pin ripple, PRE-EXISTING and unrelated to REQ-1: my diff touches only lean/Thermite/Strat/* (new), lean/Thermite/PinFiniteEscape.lean (new), lean/Thermite/Spike/* (deleted), scripts/lean-axiom-probe.sh — NONE governed by any spec-routes.toml route, so REQ-1 introduces 0 new drift. Per the shepherd-repin-gate convention the 6 stale pins are the orchestrator's to re-pin before merge; agent skips.
